title: Shrinking-Target Limit and Interval Calibration for Accepted-Only Pair-Switching Rerandomization without Burn-In
banked_reason: Stage 0.5 (typed) BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: achieved incremental < field, paper_score_ceiling 6.2 < 7.4, not salvageable in scope; sound marked sphere endpoint, full positive/diverging cadence frontier remains open.
gap_reasons: The delivered contribution is the actual marked sphere endpoint and its calibration consequences on a fixed categorical shrinking-target subclass; the accepted-only correspondence is supported by the public [Algorithm 3 text](https://arxiv.org/html/2602.07613). The original-DIM undercoverage and correction require residual amplitude to shrink as sqrt(a_n), so they establish sensitivity near affine prognosis rather than a general-outcome inference correction. The cadence theorem settles only lambda_n tending to zero: the auxiliary F_{K,lambda}, core-mass bounds and cutoff-energy upper bounds establish neither actual positive-cadence laws nor the proposed diverging-cadence correction. The main framing respects these limits, but Setup's descriptions of the full H_{K,lambda} family and computable delta_n as 'DERIVED' are stale because marked-flux-family leaves them open. The Berry–Esseen leaf needs explicit attribution to [Wang–Li (2022), Theorem A2(iii)](https://arxiv.org/html/2109.02578), which covers its statement; the banked predecessor comparison has no archival theorem text supplied for independent assessment. The projected score is constrained by the narrow covariate and outcome scope, the incomplete cadence characterization, and the absence of finite-sample coverage evidence within the maintained class, since lower-dimensional and empty-target diagnostics do not establish operational performance. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.2 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

proof_attempt_summary: Derived the actual joint marked sphere law for literal accepted-only stopping and all dense proposal cadences, plus conditional-label transfer and original-record DIM calibration for shrinking residuals. The cadence-1 test yielded core-mass and cutoff-energy bounds but did not establish weighted relaxation or normalized marked-resolvent transfer, leaving positive and diverging cadence laws and the full computable remainder open. Citation-cleared typed D0.5 stopped below the field floor at incremental (score 6.2 versus 7.4); independent audits confirmed downgraded banking, with minor panel and stale setup-label findings preserved and no Lean formalization attempted.
tldr: On a legal strict subclass of Lu--Zhang--Zhu's general Algorithm 3 inputs, the literal accepted-only rule with no burn-in has a sphere, rather than uniform-acceptable-ball, shrinking-target limit. The legal constant-effect witness gives limiting undercoverage from uniform-ball critical values at every fixed nominal level. Sphere calibration gives computable conservative intervals for original unadjusted DIM at scale \(\sqrt{a_n/n}\), with asymptotic exactness under constant effects, in the narrower near-affine outcome class. The new proposal-clock design has a proved dense-cadence endpoint \(s_n/(na_n)\to0\). Actual finite-positive and diverging cadence laws, sharp ball equivalence, and a computable total approximation remainder remain open.
gap: Lu--Zhang--Zhu leave rigorous characterization of practical implicit burn-in unresolved. Existing shrinking-threshold and residual-relative inference results concern uniform or independent-candidate allocation. The missing result is an exact shrinking-target marked output law for the no-burn-in allocation chain, not a new generic inference baseline.
fill: Derive the actual full-count stopped law and cadence endpoints, certify low-dimensional numerical calibration, and transfer the marked law to feasible original-DIM intervals in the disclosed prognosis sensitivity regime. A companion decomposition gives the boundary of first-order inferential relevance. The principal open question retains its annular soft-capacity handle and destructive hidden-mode test.
